title: Hearty Hydro Blue German Cabbage Bao
description: A festive German dish featuring blue food coloring and raw-friendly ingredients, served in a bento box. This floral and bouncy-qq dish is perfect for a unique meal.
instructions: Shred the cabbage and carrots, and set them aside in separate bowls.
Slice the onion into thin rings and separate them into individual pieces.
In a large bowl, mix together the shredded cabbage, grated carrots, and sliced onion.
Add the blue food coloring to the bowl and toss until the mixture is evenly colored.
Slice the german sausage into thin pieces and add them to the bowl.
In a small bowl, mix together the brine and sesame seeds.
Brush the brine mixture onto the baos.
Spoon the cabbage mixture onto the baos, leaving a small border around the edges.
Top the cabbage mixture with a slice of german sausage.
Serve the baos in a bento box and garnish with additional sesame seeds if desired.
